study: Forecast Maturity of Technical Performance Margin on NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Data
finding: Fixed checkpoints remove future-horizon dependence. Across the three cells that later cross 1.4 Ah, mean absolute threshold-cycle error falls from 102.399 cycles at checkpoint 40 to 35.852 at 60 and 11.942 at 80. Mean forecast revision falls from 100.046 cycles between checkpoints 40→60 to 38.012 between 60→80, but substantial cell-level instability remains. At checkpoint 80, B0007 projects a crossing near cycle 158.219 although no 1.4 Ah crossing is observed through cycle 168.
source: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence Battery Data Set (B0005, B0006, B0007, B0018)
